definition: [ נשׁם ] verb pant (Late Hebrew in nouns נְשִׁימָה , נְשָׁמָה , ᵑ7 נִשְׁמָא , נִשְׁמְתָא ; late Aramaic Ithpe`el; Syriac breathe, blow ; Arabic gently breathe (of wind), etc.; see seek a thing with labour and perseverance ( Lane 3032 ); a soul , Lane ib .); — pant , of the deep and strong breathing of a woman in travail; Qal Imperfect 1 singular אֶשֹּׁם Isa 42:14 .
